sets.title: Classic
sets.description: The original Mr.doob neighbour-line family from The Scribbler. Each brush buffers stroke points and draws faint connecting lines, so dense areas naturally fill in and shapes emerge from motion.

brushes.name: sketchy
brushes.summary: Faint diagonals link each new point to nearby past ones, with mid-segment cuts so the web stays airy.
brushes.goodFor: Loose figure sketches and gestural studies — tone builds up gradually as you explore a shape.

brushes.name: shaded
brushes.summary: Wide soft band stroke that builds value with overlapping passes.
brushes.goodFor: Suggesting volume and mood in a sketch with broad, atmospheric passes.

brushes.name: chrome
brushes.summary: Reflected offset lines along the stroke create a polished metallic ribbon.
brushes.goodFor: Decorative flourishes and ribbon-like accents within a sketch.

brushes.name: fur
brushes.summary: Short upward bristles stamped along the stroke.
brushes.goodFor: A fluffy or feathered edge along the contour of a quick sketch.

brushes.name: longfur
brushes.summary: Long vertical hairs trailing from the stroke.
brushes.goodFor: A wispy, falling-hair sensation following a drawn line.

brushes.name: web
brushes.summary: All-pairs connection at low alpha — denser, more web-like than Sketchy.
brushes.goodFor: A dense, cobweb-like texture for moody or stylised sketches.

sets.title: Geometric
sets.description: Hard-edged primitives that paint shapes rather than tones. Useful as building blocks when a sketch needs structure or rhythm.

brushes.name: simple
brushes.summary: A plain solid line — the calibrator brush.
brushes.goodFor: Clean reference marks where the other brushes feel too expressive.

brushes.name: squares
brushes.summary: Stamps a rotated rectangle along motion direction.
brushes.goodFor: A blocky, architectural feel — quick mass studies and glitch-style motifs.

brushes.name: ribbon
brushes.summary: Twisting wave stroke that loops around the cursor.
brushes.goodFor: A sense of motion or banner-like flourish in a sketch.

brushes.name: circles
brushes.summary: Concentric rings stamped at the cursor.
brushes.goodFor: A halo, ripple, or target feel around a focal point of the drawing.

brushes.name: grid
brushes.summary: Lays down grid intersections under the cursor.
brushes.goodFor: Light technical fills or layout reference beneath a sketch.

sets.title: Atmospheric
sets.description: Painterly and effects-driven brushes that don't follow the neighbour-line idea — they paint texture directly to set a mood.

brushes.name: neon
brushes.summary: Soft blurred glow stacked under a hard core line — the classic glow tube.
brushes.goodFor: A neon-glow vibe — magical or signage-like accents, especially on a dark canvas.

brushes.name: watercolor
brushes.summary: Wet bleed with soft-edged dabs that mix with the canvas.
brushes.goodFor: A loose, washy feel for organic backgrounds and expressive ink studies.

brushes.name: splatter
brushes.summary: Random ink dots scattered around the cursor.
brushes.goodFor: Speckle and grit overlaid on a sketch for a distressed sensation.

brushes.name: calligraphy
brushes.summary: Pen-nib width modulated by stroke direction.
brushes.goodFor: A nibbed, calligraphic feel — stylised lettering or comic-ink sketching.

brushes.name: smoke
brushes.summary: Stacked translucent ovals that drift and dissipate.
brushes.goodFor: A soft, smoky atmosphere drifting through a sketch.

brushes.name: stipple
brushes.summary: Hand-placed dots, dense at the cursor and sparse around it.
brushes.goodFor: A stippled, pointillist sensation — like a quick etching study.

brushes.name: lightning
brushes.summary: Jagged forking line with random displacement.
brushes.goodFor: An electric, energetic mark — arcs or cracks in a sketch.

brushes.name: chalk
brushes.summary: Granular dry-brush texture with scattered particles.
brushes.goodFor: A chalky, weathered surface feel — like sketching on a blackboard.

sets.title: Exotic
sets.description: Riffs on the Mr.doob neighbour-line mechanic, each twisting one parameter to produce a distinct emergent texture.

brushes.name: mycelium
brushes.summary: Sketchy-style connections that occasionally fork to a third nearby point.
brushes.goodFor: An organic, branching sensation — root systems or fungal-network studies.

brushes.name: magnetic
brushes.summary: Neighbour links rendered as bulging quadratic Bezier arcs.
brushes.goodFor: A curling, field-line feel — sketches that suggest magnetism or flow.

brushes.name: constellation
brushes.summary: Bright dot at the cursor connected to the 3 nearest past points.
brushes.goodFor: A star-map sensation — minimal, dotted sketches with linking filaments.

brushes.name: echo
brushes.summary: Sketchy with a sliding window of the last 24 points and age-based fade.
brushes.goodFor: A motion-aware sketch where trails fade behind the cursor.

brushes.name: stringart
brushes.summary: Connects only to past points opposite the cursor across a moving centroid.
brushes.goodFor: A nail-and-thread, math-art feel — geometric envelopes built up from gesture.

sets.title: Math
sets.description: Brushes drawn from computational geometry. The result is a structure derived from your stroke rather than a stylised line.

brushes.name: voronoi
brushes.summary: Draws the perpendicular bisector between the cursor and its nearest past point.
brushes.goodFor: A cellular-partition sensation — biological or diagrammatic sketches.

brushes.name: delaunay
brushes.summary: Angle-sorted spokes plus a ring among the 5 nearest neighbours.
brushes.goodFor: A low-poly, triangular-mesh feel for structural sketches.

brushes.name: hull
brushes.summary: Periodically strokes the convex hull of recent stroke points.
brushes.goodFor: Wrapping a sketch in a tightening envelope — gesture and motion studies.

brushes.name: tangent
brushes.summary: Each connection becomes a perpendicular tick at its midpoint.
brushes.goodFor: A bristled, force-line sensation — sketches that suggest direction or tension.

sets.title: Inked
sets.description: Illustrative variations on the neighbour-line idea that produce traditional drawing textures — hatched, blotted, woven.

brushes.name: crosshatch
brushes.summary: Each connection is replaced by 3 perpendicular ticks along it.
brushes.goodFor: An engraving or etching sensation — classical hatched shading over a sketch.

brushes.name: knit
brushes.summary: Connects to the past point most perpendicular to the cursor's velocity.
brushes.goodFor: A braided, woven feel — sketches that suggest knit or knotted forms.

brushes.name: inkblot
brushes.summary: Density-scaled ink pools at midpoints of neighbour-lines.
brushes.goodFor: A wet, blotchy ink sensation — organic stain studies.

brushes.name: halo
brushes.summary: Circle at each point with radius equal to its nearest-neighbour distance.
brushes.goodFor: A cell-packing or halo feel — sketches of how points relate spatially.

sets.title: Studio
sets.description: Polished modern brushes built for everyday illustration — texture and feel rather than emergent structure.

brushes.name: pixel
brushes.summary: Snaps to a coarse pixel grid for retro pixel-art looks.
brushes.goodFor: A pixelated, lo-fi sensation in a sketch — like roughing in over a coarse grid.

brushes.name: oil
brushes.summary: Thick wet-edge brush with smearing transparency.
brushes.goodFor: A painterly, oil-like feel for broad, expressive strokes.

brushes.name: crayon
brushes.summary: Waxy layered marks with grainy edges.
brushes.goodFor: A waxy, crayon-on-paper feel — playful, textured colour sketches.

brushes.name: sparkle
brushes.summary: Stars and tiny twinkles scattered around the cursor.
brushes.goodFor: A magical-dust sensation — decorative twinkles to lift a sketch.

brushes.name: hatching
brushes.summary: Diagonal hatching lines laid down beneath every stroke.
brushes.goodFor: A quick hatched-shading pass over an existing sketch.

sets.title: Tools
sets.description: Utilities — not brushes in the painting sense.

brushes.name: eraser
brushes.summary: Removes ink from the canvas.
brushes.goodFor: Cleaning up or masking parts of a sketch.
